response.overview: What is a Black Hole? What is the future of our sun? What amazing secrets has the Hubble Deep Field project revealed? Explore these mysteries and many more as remarkable new discoveries in deep space unfold before you.  You'll see the explosion of a supernova, a once-in-a-century event. You'll go hunting for new planets. You'll watch galaxies collide, wander the red planet, Mars, for traces of life, look back in time fifteen billion years - and more! Stunning images taken directly from deepest space, plus colorful computer animation combine with an Emmy-nominated musical score to make this remarkable Reader's Digest program one the whole family will enjoy over and over again.
response.title: Mysteries of Deep Space
